task:
Context. You are one of several builders implementing the Project Swiftie redesign (formerly Swiftie Quiz) in this Flutter desktop app for macOS and Windows (Flutter 3.47.5, Dart 3.13, Riverpod 3, Dart package name swiftie_quiz). Other builders change other files at the same time: create, change or delete only the files listed for this step, and leave git alone (no commits, stashes, resets, checkouts or branch changes).

Design reference. docs/specs/project-swiftie-redesign.design/ holds the high-fidelity handoff: README.md (tokens, screens, motion, copy) and Project Swiftie.dc.html, an HTML template whose markup gives exact sizes, colours and copy, followed from line 1022 by a JavaScript logic block whose renderVals() at line 1657 computes every displayed value. Line numbers in this task refer to that HTML file. Colours, type, spacing, motion and copy are final; match them exactly, in both the dark and the light theme. Never port anything tagged PROTOTYPE-ONLY (SAMPLE lyric lines, FALL titles, jsonp, seedStats or seedUnlocked, simulated updater timings, multiplayer bots, the platform, network, update and birthday tweak props). Play together (multiplayer) is not part of this work: build no part of it.

Already on the base branch (the routing scaffold). GamePhase in lib/domain/models/game_types.dart is nickname, menu, albumSelect, setup, lyricsLoading, playing, roundSummary, recordShelf, settings; GameMode is random, album, tonight. lib/app/app.dart routes nickname to NicknameScreen (lib/ui/screens/nickname_screen.dart), menu to MainMenu, albumSelect to AlbumGrid, setup to SetupScreen (lib/ui/screens/setup_screen.dart), lyricsLoading to LyricsLoadingScreen, playing to GameScreen or LyricsGameScreen by quiz type, roundSummary to RoundSummaryScreen (lib/ui/screens/round_summary_screen.dart), recordShelf to RecordShelfScreen (lib/ui/screens/record_shelf_screen.dart) and settings to SettingsScreen. The shell is a Column: AppTitleBar (lib/ui/chrome/title_bar.dart) above a Stack holding the screen inside UpdateOverlay, then MisuHost (lib/ui/misu/misu_host.dart), then ToastHost. NicknameScreen, SetupScreen, RoundSummaryScreen, RecordShelfScreen, AppTitleBar and MisuHost are placeholders that their own steps replace. lib/domain/models/edition.dart defines enum Edition { ana, open }; lib/state/edition_provider.dart defines editionProvider, a Provider<Edition> read from --dart-define=EDITION ("ana" gives Edition.ana, anything else Edition.open); tests override it. lib/domain/models/era.dart defines Era (key, deezerAlbumId, eraName, subLabel, placeholderArgb), curatedEras (the 12 eras in design order), dayOfYear(DateTime), tonightsEra(DateTime) and eraForAlbumId(int). pubspec.yaml registers the font family Instrument Serif (regular and italic, assets/fonts/) and the asset folder assets/brand/, which holds the Misu cat-note icon SVGs app-icon.svg, app-icon-small.svg, app-icon-macos.svg, app-icon-macos-small.svg and mark.svg. assets/cat/cat-icon.svg is the Misu vector of the design, drawn by CatIcon(height:) in lib/ui/cat/cat_icon.dart; the design's cat loader already exists as CatLoader (lib/ui/cat/cat_loader.dart) with LoadingGate (lib/ui/cat/loading_gate.dart). Reuse those; never rebuild them. The v0.3.0 layout helpers that used to live in lib/ui/screens/main_menu.dart (ScreenScaffold, CenteredScreen, MaxWidthBox, BackHeader, ScreenHeading, GridColumns, ResponsiveGrid, HoverTransition, PlainButton, LocalDates, TailwindBreakpoints, TailwindContainers, spacedVertically and the SpringTo extension) now live in lib/ui/widgets/screen_layout.dart, and the Motion, MotionPose and MotionPresence animation widgets that used to live in lib/ui/game/result_feedback.dart now live in lib/ui/widgets/motion.dart; screens that still need them import those files. Only the design-system step edits lib/app/app.dart, and no step edits pubspec.yaml.

Your step. Build the design system every other screen of the redesign uses: theme tokens, layout metrics, type, motion and the shared kit widgets, with the exact API below, because later steps are written against it.

Tokens. Keep lerp and copyWith covering every field so the theme cross-fades. Type. Set heights as line-height divided by font size. The font assets are already registered in pubspec.yaml by the scaffold; do not edit pubspec.yaml.

Motion. Extend lib/ui/theme/app_motion.dart (keep what other code still uses) with: screenFade 280 ms Curves.ease; screenRise 400 ms Cubic(.2,.8,.2,1) and screenRiseOffset 10; hoverLift 200 ms Cubic(.34,1.56,.64,1) and hoverLiftOffset 1; pressScale 0.97; rowHoverPad 250 ms Cubic(.2,.8,.2,1) to 8 px; recordFlip 550 ms Cubic(.4,0,.2,1); discDegreesPerMs 0.2; beadPop 450 ms (scale 0 to 1.25 to 1); quackBurst 1300 ms; misuRise 450 ms Cubic(.34,1.3,.64,1); misuBubbleDelay 120 ms; misuStay 4200 ms; misuStayLong 7000 ms; toastSlide 350 ms over 24 px; toastSpacing 84; toastStay 4 s; themeFade 300 ms; and static bool reduced(BuildContext) true when MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) is true.

Kit. Create these widgets in lib/ui/kit/, each in its own file named above, styled from the HTML lines given, in both themes, with hover, press and focus states and reduced motion respected. ScreenEnter(child:) fades from 0 over screenFade and rises 10 px over screenRise on first build. TwoPane(left:, right:) puts left in a column of AppLayout.leftColumn width with a 1 px line border on its right and right in the remaining width; below 900 px it stacks left above right in one scrollable column (menu at lines 82 to 134 and README Screens). PillButton(label:, onPressed:, kind:, size:, enabled:, leading:) is the rounded 999 pill: coral (coral bg, onCoral text, w600), solid (btn bg, onBtn text), outline (1 px line2 border, fg text), quiet (mut text, hover bg hover and text fg), danger (rose bg, bg-coloured text); PillSize.large pads 14 by 26 at 16/20 (nickname button line 77) and PillSize.regular pads 10 by 18 at 14/20 (dialog buttons lines 978 to 980); hover lifts 1 px over hoverLift, press scales to 0.97, disabled draws at 0.45 opacity and ignores taps and keys. ArrowRow(title:, description:, onTap:, primary:) is the menu row at lines 115 to 123: serif title at AppLayout.rowTitle, line-height 1.1, description 15/22 mut, 26 px vertical padding, 1 px line bottom border, a 44 px circle holding → at the right (primary: coral fill and border with onCoral arrow; otherwise transparent fill, line2 border, fg arrow), and on hover the left padding grows 0 to 8 px over rowHoverPad. TextLink(label:, onTap:) is the link at lines 124 to 130: 14/20 mut turning fg on hover, at least 44 px tall. ChoiceRow and OptionTile are the Listen or read choice rows and the Difficulty tiles of the set-up screen at lines 190 to 256 (radio ring coral when selected and line2 otherwise, designCard fill when selected, radius 14; read the exact paddings there). Segmented<T>(options:, value:, onChanged:) is the settings segmented control in lines 535 to 615: a pill track whose selected segment has btn fill and onBtn text and whose others are transparent with mut text turning fg on hover. SectionLabel(text) is 12/16 w600 mut. SerifInput is the underline input of the nickname screen (line 75: italic serif at a given size and line height, 1 px line2 bottom border turning coral on focus, coral caret, faint placeholder, no fill) and of the Hard answer field (lines 416 to 429). VinylDisc(size:, labelUrl:, labelColor:, labelFraction: 0.35, showLabelImage:) paints concentric grooves alternating g1 and g2 (1 px g1 then 1.5 px g2, as repeating-radial-gradient at line 105), an inset 1 px ring rgba(245,229,212,.12), a drop shadow of shadow colour, a round label of labelColor or the cover image, and a small centre hole. AlbumSleeve(size:, coverUrl:, placeholder:, radius: 3) shows the network cover (Image.network) over its placeholder colour, clipped to the radius, with the shadow at line 108. Bead(color:, size: 12, pop:) is a circle with a subtle inner ring that springs 0 to 1.25 to 1 over beadPop when pop is true. confirm_dialog.dart exports showConfirmDialog(context, title:, message:, confirmLabel:, destructive: false) built on SwiftieModal, styled as lines 972 to 984 (panel, radius 16, line2 border, title serif 30/34, message 15/22 mut, Cancel as a quiet pill, confirm as a coral pill or a danger pill when destructive); it returns Future<bool>, false on Esc, Cancel or a scrim click and true on confirm. swiftie_modal.dart exports SwiftieModal(child:, maxWidth:, onDismiss:, bare: false): a full-window scrim of the scrim colour with a 4 px backdrop blur and a centred panel (panel fill, 1 px line2 border, radius 16, 26 by 26 by 22 padding, shadow) that rises in; bare: true draws only the scrim and blur around the child so a caller can draw its own card; scrim clicks call onDismiss. modal_stack.dart exports modalStackProvider, a NotifierProvider whose state is an unmodifiable list of open modal keys, with push(Object key) and remove(Object key); callers check the list's isEmpty. SwiftieModal (a ConsumerStatefulWidget) pushes a unique key when shown and removes it when disposed, and handles Esc only while it is the last entry, calling onDismiss; this is the single place Esc and dialog-open state are arbitrated, so the update dialog, confirm dialogs and the birthday card stack correctly and game shortcuts and Misu can check that no dialog is open. Restyle BackLink in lib/ui/widgets/back_link.dart, keeping its constructor and keeping the word Back as its own Text widget (existing tests find it by that text), to the design's back link ("← Back" at lines 196, 501 and 538: 14/20 mut turning fg on hover).

API you must provide. Later steps are written against exactly these names and shapes: PillKind { coral, solid, outline, quiet, danger } and PillSize { large, regular }; ChoiceRow and OptionTile both take title:, description:, selected:, onTap:; Segmented<T> takes options: as a List<(T, String)> of (value, label) records, value: and onChanged:; SerifInput takes controller:, placeholder:, fontSize:, lineHeight:, maxLength:, onSubmitted:, autofocus: and enabled:; VinylDisc and AlbumSleeve both live in vinyl.dart; Bead takes color:, size: (default 12) and pop:; showConfirmDialog takes context, title:, message:, confirmLabel: and destructive:; SwiftieModal takes child:, maxWidth:, onDismiss: and bare:.

Tests. Rewrite test/ui/theme/app_tokens_test.dart around the new design fields; add test/ui/theme/app_layout_test.dart, test/ui/theme/app_type_test.dart, test/ui/kit/kit_test.dart (including a Segmented test that the chosen segment paints btn with onBtn text and the others are transparent with mut text, and a modal stack test) and test/ui/theme/theme_fade_test.dart (pump the app shell the way test/app/app_test.dart's harness does, with editionProvider overridden to Edition.ana, and assert the MaterialApp's themeAnimationDuration is 300 ms and the shell paints bg). Keep every other existing test passing.

Rules. Models and state are immutable: final fields, const constructors, copyWith and unmodifiable collections; build new objects instead of mutating. lib/domain imports no package:flutter, dart:io or dart:ui. No print or debugPrint in lib. Side effects (network, files, audio, window control, process launching) live only in lib/data and lib/services behind injected collaborators. Never write code comments, docstrings or section-header comments, and never use emojis. Respect reduced motion: when MediaQuery.disableAnimations is true every animation is instant. Every interactive target is at least 24 by 24 logical pixels, reachable by keyboard and shows a visible focus ring. Write the acceptance tests named below with exactly those names (flutter test --plain-name matches them); each must fail without your change and pass with it, and must load the code under test inside the test body so a missing implementation fails the named test.

Never edit a file outside your list. If a change you must make breaks an existing test in a file you do not own, first look for a way to make your change that keeps it passing; if there is none, finish and name that test and why in your final message.

Done means: the acceptance tests exist and pass; dart format lib test tool leaves nothing to change; flutter analyze --fatal-infos is clean; the whole flutter test suite passes, including tests you had to update because the screen they cover changed. Do not launch the app: the orchestrator checks every screen visually on the integrated build.
